stories.excerpt: All Japan Kudo Federation 2026 Hokuto Flag All Japan Kudo Physical Fitness Championship Saturday, November 21, 2026 Tokyo, National Yoyogi Stadium Second Gymnasium [Photo] Front row is the winner of each class, back row is the runner-up of each class Kuudo is a clothed mixed martial arts sport in which people wear dogi, fist supports, and head protection, and compete using blows including headbutts, elbows, and knees, as well as throwing techniques and ground techniques. Next year, in November 2027, the World Championship (7th edition) will be held once every four years. Japan's representatives for the 2027 World Championships will be determined based on their results at this year's and next spring's All-Japan Championships (in principle, two players in each category for men and women). Normally, the Autumn All Japan Championships are held in the open weight category, but the World Championships are held in categories based on physical fitness (height + weight), so this tournament was held based on physical fitness. In the men's 230 and under category, Yuta Meguro (Daidojuku Nagaoka Branch, 34 years old) achieved an astonishing 10th consecutive victory.
stories.originalExcerpt: 全日本空道連盟 2026北斗旗全日本空道体力別選手権大会 2026年11月21日(土)東京・国立代々木競技場第二体育館 【写真】前列が各階級の優勝者、後列が各階級の準優勝者 道衣・拳サポーター・頭部防具を着用し、頭突き・肘・膝を含む打撃と、投げ技・寝技によって争う着衣総合格闘技「空道（くうどう）」。来年2027年11月には、4年に1度の世界選手権（第7回大会）が開催される。 2027年世界選手権・日本代表選手は、今回と来春の全日本選手権での成績により、決定される（男女各カテゴリーで原則2名）。通常秋の全日本選手権は無差別級で行われるが、世界選手権は体力別（身長＋体重の体力指数で階級別けされる）で行われるため、今大会は体力別で実施された。 男子230以下では目黒雄太（大道塾長岡支部＝34歳）が驚異の10連覇を達成

stories.excerpt: The special round girls, presenters, and guest commentators for ``K-1 REVENGE II'' held at Korakuen Hall, Tokyo on Monday, November 23, 2026 (holiday) have been decided. Terumi Ishibashi, a highly educated and high-spec girl who is active as an actor and gravure idol, will serve as the special round girl. In 2026, Ishibashi will appear in ABEMA's "Otoko Shine House 2" as a nurse. She has attracted attention as the "eternal female college student ∞" and is active in a wide range of fields including gravure, TV and drama.
